roles.name: Spot Interaction
roles.description: Answers or protects one spell, ability, permanent, or player. Mechanics identify the response mode.

roles.name: Mass Interaction
roles.description: Answers or protects multiple objects or players at once. Mechanics identify the response mode.

roles.name: Ramp
roles.description: Accelerates mana availability beyond the normal land drop.

roles.name: Card Advantage
roles.description: Provides net or repeatable access to additional usable resources; one-for-one replacement and filtering alone do not qualify.
